up: Retrieve IC50 activity records for dapagliflozin (CHEMBL429910) and all its salt/derivative forms against the target sodium/glucose cotransporter 2 (CHEMBL3884). Join `activities` with `assays`, `target_dictionary`, `molecule_hierarchy`, `molecule_dictionary`, `compound_structures`, and `docs`. Use `activities.molregno = molecule_hierarchy.molregno` and `molecule_hierarchy.parent_molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno` to match the parent compound and all its salts. Filter for `activities.standard_type = 'IC50'`, `target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3884'`, and `molecule_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL429910'`. Return compound identifiers (`molecule_dictionary.chembl_id`, `molecule_dictionary.pref_name`), structures (`compound_structures.canonical_smiles`, `compound_structures.standard_inchi_key`), activity values (`activities.standard_value`, `activities.standard_units`, `activities.standard_relation`), assay details (`assays.assay_id`, `assays.description`, `assays.assay_type`, `assays.bao_format`), and literature references (`docs.doc_id`, `docs.chembl_id`, `docs.year`, `docs.doi`, `docs.pubmed_id`, `docs.title`). Do not apply row limits.
sql:
SELECT
    md2.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    md2.pref_name AS compound_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    cs.standard_inchi_key,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.standard_relation,
    ass.assay_id,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    ass.assay_type,
    ass.bao_format,
    d.doc_id,
    d.chembl_id AS doc_chembl_id,
    d.year,
    d.doi,
    d.pubmed_id,
    d.title
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = md.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md2 ON md2.molregno = mh.molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.molregno = mh.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = mh.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL429910'
    AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3884'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
